set.body:
The assessor receives the precomputed S3 graph and S4 promotions instead of reconstructing them.
Per recall claim it outputs: which source referent each recall argument binds to (with basis and
competing alternatives), which occurrence or state is remembered, then each attribute judged
separately, so a wrong gender or clothing modifier no longer erases correct posture and location.
Local source findings and attributed recall findings are both preserved; uncertain attribution
leaves the local fact available without recall credit.

Acceptance: S1 suite passes; no previously correct component lost on the frozen set;
natural-u23-r740/c2 no longer wrongly contradicted.
set.title: [evidence-binding S5] Bind recall arguments to the source graph; judge attributes separately
